browserReplay.note: Replayed author-supplied focused assertions against the final production server. Receipt mode is named browser because --production was intentionally omitted to preserve the root production receipt.

independentReview: Linux pathname edits/presets restore final current result; process cursor steps are clamped to current resolution and reset on edits.
Linux stream routes, producer failure and reset update diagram, destination text and exit status from the same derived model.

NumPy selection/broadcast/reduction reset selected-cell indices when shape choices change; invalid broadcasts expose the shape error without dereferencing an absent active cell. Memory write remains a genuine process action.

K-Means fixture/center changes restart the process trace; seeding probability is recomputed from selected centers; hierarchy partition controls derive the current cut; palette changes clamp count to the image limit.
Diagonal subset and factorial labs derive live outputs from current membership/interaction inputs; reset restores the corresponding initial states.

Inspected four rendered captures: desktop geometry and phone hierarchy, streams and NumPy broadcasting. Labels, controls, current outcomes and linked geometry are readable; no answer-entry or reveal gate appears.
